The primary '''starport''' for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] was located in the [[Xucphra Corporation district]] of [[Xucphra City|Zalxuc City]], near the [[Xucphra Corporate Headquarters]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] was used to transport [[Alazhi/Legends|alazhi]] bacteria and [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] off-world.<ref name="Strongholds" />
